**Finding submitted: deviation (medium, commercial) — MINCOMMIT**

- **No express commitment language:** searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall" and "volume" returned nothing; § 4.1 (p0052) states charges are one-time, installment, recurring or usage as specified in Service Option Attachments, and § 3.5 limits termination liability to accrued amounts. § 11.5 imposes capacity-planning responsibility on Customer but no committed forecast.
- **Residual take-or-pay risk:** § 3.4(b) (p0046) makes Customer's convenience-termination right contingent on undefined "early termination charges" in Attachment A / Service Option Attachments, which — with automatic same-length renewals under § 3.2 — amounts to an open-ended penalty for Services never received.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** replaced the early termination charge with a true-up limited to IBM's actual, unavoidable direct costs, expressly disclaiming any minimum purchase or volume commitment and confirming no payment for Services not rendered; the existing one-month exit right is untouched. Fallback (12-month commitment reducible on 30 days' notice with a true-up) is offered in the comment.
